securityBoundary.dnsRule: Every resolved IPv4/IPv6 address had to be globally routable

findings: All nine non-allowlisted fresh-token URIs were safely reachable in this bounded sample and were byte-stable after 60 seconds.
Eight returned metadata JSON; one URI returned image/png directly, proving the creation URI is not universally a JSON document across all launchpads.
Arbitrary HTTPS bytes are mutable and provider-dependent even when short-term hashes match.
A production fetcher must revalidate DNS and every redirect, block non-global addresses, cap bytes/time/decompression, treat Content-Type as untrusted, and store response hashes/failure states.
